newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde - July 31.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde - July 31.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.

-- A report on immigration presented to Prime Minister Lionel Jospin calls for openings for foreign scholars or investors, favours family regrouping, but would deny access to unskilled workers. It also calls for a broader scope for political asylum.

-- Government to present the latest bailout plan for Credit Lyonnais today to the European Commission. Plan is to postpone the bank's privatisation for two to three years and include 3.6 billion francs of aid in exchange for a sale by Credit Lyonnais of more than half of its European subsidiary network.
-- Insurer GAN to be privatised before the end of June 1998.
-- French businesses' investment rose 5.3 percent in 1996 from 1995.
